headline: Kazakhstan Seeks $6.5M Fine From Nazarbayev-Linked Oil Firm
summary: Kazakhstan is seeking to recover over 3 billion tenge ($6.5 million) in environmental fines from oil company Zhan i KS over drilling waste violations in the Atyrau region.
why: Zhan i KS is an oil enterprise linked to the family of former president Nursultan Nazarbayev operating in Kazakhstan's energy sector.

impacts.name: Kazakhstan
impacts.why: Enforcement of environmental penalties increases state budget revenues from resource sectors.
